name: OHIP MCP Server
description: A universal gateway for the Oracle Hospitality Interface Platform (OHIP) that enables AI assistants to execute authenticated API requests for hotel management tasks like reservations and inventory. It features automated OAuth 2.0 token management and secure credential handling for seamless integration with Oracle Hospitality services.
